Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system

Class Proc

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.Proc
public final class Proc extends Object
Low-level readers for the Linux /proc and /sys pseudo filesystems, plus the two getconf constants (page size and clock ticks per second) needed to turn raw kernel counters into bytes and CPU seconds.

Every read is defensive: a missing or unreadable file yields an empty result rather than an exception, because these files come and go (a process can exit between listing /proc and reading its stat file) and because the desktop must keep running on kernels/containers that expose only a subset of them.

Field indices below refer to the 1-based field numbers documented in proc(5).
